text:
alex: heads-up: ran into this gem in infra.yaml while debugging a flakey deploy:
```yaml
service: metrics
version: 1...0
```
alex: CI somehow didn't catch it and prod rolled with it for a minute :sweat_smile:
tasha: 1...0 is how semver expresses mystery and sorrow :crystal_ball:
omar: compiler murmurs: 'i do not understand your range' :robot_face:
build-bot: build failed — invalid semver '1...0' (exit 1) :x:
tasha: propose new bot message when semver is broken: "Please describe your feelings about versions in one line"
alex: also thinking of adding a tiny commit hook that turns `1...0` into `1.0.0` and a haiku notification
omar: haiku notifications are non-negotiable. sample:
```yaml
# haiku linter output
quiet pipeline hums
three dots become too many
please semver me lol
```
tasha: if we get too poetic we should still gate by a real linter. 
omar: agreed. but i will miss the era of accidental ellipsis-versions. good times. :wave:
